`spec_text` arrays are defined in the JSON schema as arrays of `conditional_text` objects (schema_defs.json `$defs/spec_text` -> `$defs/conditional_text`), not plain strings. This method now accepts `String` elements inside the array, which diverges from the schema and can hide invalid input. Consider removing the `statement.is_a?(String)` branch (or, if you want to support mixed arrays, update the schema so `spec_text` array items are a `oneOf` string/conditional_text).
```suggestion
      # According to the JSON schema, spec_text array items are conditional_text objects (hashes),

      next unless statement.is_a?(Hash)

      text = statement['text']
      condition = statement['when()']
```
